title: navigation by position (api >= 2.13): 3x3 grid, comparison rules on irregular layouts, nav override

steps.note: overlap on the cross axis beats a smaller gap
among overlapping candidates the smaller gap wins
no overlap, equal gaps: smaller cross-axis center distance wins
candidate whose top edge is above the current top is excluded even if its center is below
candidate overlapping in the moving direction (gap 0)
right: candidate left edge must not be left of current left
up with overlapping and non-overlapping candidates
nav override to an available control wins
nav to a disabled control: normal search
nav to an unknown id: normal search
nav to a label id: normal search
nav to a composite: its default part (value item)
nav set only for another direction
nav on a radio is accepted but ignored
